tools.name: Burnwell
tools.description: The safe way to send someone a password, API key or recovery phrase — type the secret, share a one-time link, and it's handed straight from your browser to theirs, end-to-end encrypted, shown once, then burned. Unlike the paste-into-a-website services, nothing is ever stored on a server: the secret only moves while you're both connected, and it's released to a single verified recipient then wiped. A four-word code catches an impostor, and a split-link mode keeps the passphrase off the link entirely.

tools.name: Sketchwell
tools.description: A private, end-to-end encrypted collaborative whiteboard you open from a link — draw together in real time with pen, shapes, arrows and text, live per-person cursors, and no account, no server and nothing stored. Every stroke goes straight browser-to-browser over an encrypted mesh and the board is kept in sync by a conflict-free CRDT; export it as a PNG or a scalable SVG to keep a copy.

tools.name: Chatwell
tools.description: A disposable, end-to-end encrypted group chat room you open from a link — share it, everyone joins with a name, and messages go straight browser-to-browser over an encrypted mesh with no account, no app and no server keeping a copy. The room is ephemeral and evaporates when everyone leaves; export a plain-text transcript first if you want to keep one.

tools.name: Beamwell
tools.description: A private 'send this to my phone' button — pair two of your own devices once by scanning a QR, then beam text, links, one-time codes and images between them instantly. Sent directly browser-to-browser and end-to-end encrypted, with no cloud clipboard, no account and nothing kept on any server; the pairing is remembered for one-tap reconnect.

tools.name: Syncwell
tools.description: Private, end-to-end encrypted live folder sync between your own devices — laptop to phone, or with one collaborator. Pick a folder on each; edits propagate directly between browsers over an encrypted channel, with no cloud, no account and nothing uploaded. It only ever adds and updates files — it never deletes.

tools.name: Castwell
tools.description: Private, end-to-end encrypted screen sharing from a link — broadcast your screen to viewers with no account, no download, nothing hosted. The pixels travel directly between browsers with no server in the path; a four-word code lets both sides verify no one's in the middle, and any viewer can keep a local clip or snapshot.

tools.name: Talkwell
tools.description: Private, end-to-end encrypted voice calls and a push-to-talk walkie-talkie from a link — no account, no download, nothing hosted. Your voice travels directly between browsers with no server in the path; a four-word code lets both sides verify no one's in the middle.

tools.name: Meetwell
tools.description: Private, end-to-end encrypted video calls from a link — no account, no download, nothing hosted. Camera and mic travel directly between browsers with no server in the path; a four-word code lets both sides verify no one's in the middle.

tools.name: Sentrywell
tools.description: Turn any browser into a private, motion-detecting security camera — it records only when something moves — or scan a video to find every moment of movement. Frame differencing runs on-device; footage is never uploaded.

tools.name: Hushwell
tools.description: Remove background noise and hiss from voice recordings — an on-device AI model (RNNoise) keeps the voice and strips fans, hum and traffic. Drop a clip or record yourself, export a clean WAV or MP3. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Redactwell
tools.description: Black out text in a PDF permanently — the covered words are physically removed, not just hidden — right in your browser. Drag boxes or find-and-redact every match of a word. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Tunewell
tools.description: A chromatic instrument tuner — tune guitar, bass, ukulele or violin by microphone or by ear, with a downloadable reference-tone pitch pipe. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Wavewell
tools.description: Turn a podcast clip, voice memo or song into a shareable waveform video — animated bars, mirror or sweeping waveform, a caption, and portrait/square/landscape output. Encoded on-device with WebCodecs; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Ditherwell
tools.description: Turn any photo into retro dithered pixel-art — 1-bit, Game Boy, CGA or an adaptive palette, with Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson and ordered dithering. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Noisewell
tools.description: A sound level meter in your browser — measure noise in dB(A) with your microphone, log it over time, and export a report (Leq, Lmax, L10/L90 as a chart and CSV). Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Vectorwell
tools.description: Turn a PNG, JPG or photo into a clean, scalable SVG — colour or black & white tracing, tuned live. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Embiggen
tools.description: Upscale and enhance small or low-resolution images with an AI super-resolution model that runs entirely in your browser — 2× or 4×. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Swatchwell
tools.description: Pick colours from your camera or any image, build a palette, and export it as CSS, JSON, PNG, SVG, ASE or GPL. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Shakewell
tools.description: Measure vibration frequency with your phone — turn the accelerometer into a seismograph, spectrum analyser and RPM meter. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Voxwell
tools.description: Change your voice in your browser — pitch, formants and effects, live from your mic or a file, exported as WAV or MP3. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Meshprep
tools.description: Check a 3D model before you print it — size, volume, holes and non-manifold edges shown in red on the model. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Reactwell
tools.description: Drop a JSX or TSX file and see the React component render instantly — transpiled in your browser, no setup, nothing uploaded.

tools.name: Glyphcut
tools.description: Shrink a font for the web — keep only the characters your site uses and export WOFF2. Licensed font files are never uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Gridwell
tools.description: Open, query and convert CSV files too big for Excel — millions of rows, filtered and exported in seconds. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Papershot
tools.description: Turn a phone photo of a document into a flat, readable PDF scan — corners found automatically, shadows lifted. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Blurwell
tools.description: Blur faces in photos and video in your browser — faces found automatically, plus your own boxes for plates and badges. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Vidwell
tools.description: Compress and trim video in your browser — shrink a big MP4 or MOV, cap the resolution, cut a clip, export a smaller MP4 with WebCodecs. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Verisum
tools.description: Compute and verify file checksums (SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5, BLAKE3…) in your browser and match a file against a published checksum — nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Clipwell
tools.description: Trim audio into clips and ringtones in your browser — drag across the waveform, fade, normalise, export MP3 or WAV. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Provenova
tools.description: The vendor-neutral system of record for quantum computing — capture, reproduce, benchmark, and attest quantum runs across any QPU or vendor.

tools.name: Screenwell
tools.description: Record your screen — with mic, system audio and an optional webcam bubble — entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Pixpress
tools.description: Compress and convert images to WebP, JPEG, AVIF or PNG entirely in your browser, with a before/after compare slider. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Textlift
tools.description: Extract text from images, screenshots and scanned PDFs entirely in your browser — plain text or searchable PDF out. Nothing is uploaded; English works offline.

tools.name: Inkwell
tools.description: Sign and fill PDFs entirely in your browser — draw, type or upload a signature, add text, dates and checkmarks. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Pagesmith
tools.description: Merge, split, reorder, rotate and delete PDF pages entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Scribewell
tools.description: Transcribe audio & video to text and subtitles (.srt/.vtt) entirely in your browser with OpenAI Whisper. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: unHEIC
tools.description: Convert iPhone HEIC & HEIF photos to JPG, PNG or WebP in your browser. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Tokenpeek
tools.description: Decode, inspect, verify, crack weak HMAC secrets and forge JSON Web Tokens entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Gifsmith
tools.description: Turn any video into an animated GIF entirely in your browser. No uploads, no watermark; works offline.

tools.name: Zipsafe
tools.description: Create and extract ZIP archives entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Veilpix
tools.description: Hide an AES-256 encrypted message or file inside an ordinary image via LSB steganography, in your browser.

tools.name: Sealbox
tools.description: Lock any file with a password in your browser using AES-256. Nothing is uploaded; works offline.

tools.name: Metascrub
tools.description: Strip hidden metadata (GPS, camera serial, timestamps) from photos losslessly, in your browser. No uploads.

tools.name: BGWipe
tools.description: Erase image backgrounds in your browser with an in-browser ML model. Photos never leave your device.

tools.name: PDF Crush
tools.description: Compress PDFs in your browser using MozJPEG WASM. No uploads, no accounts, no server.

tools.name: Dropwell
tools.description: End-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer file sharing in the browser.

tools.name: QRForge
tools.description: Generate tracking-free QR codes and scan them, entirely in your browser.
